briefing: Markets were flat today (NASDAQ +0.2%, S&P 500 -0.1%) with no clear risk-on signal, and available cash ($289.29) sits below the $500 deployment threshold anyway. Holding all 7 existing positions and waiting for a stronger setup before committing new capital.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Dry powder means keeping cash on hand instead of investing it immediately, so you have capital ready to deploy when a genuinely strong opportunity appears. On a neutral day like today, forcing a purchase just to put idle cash to work can mean buying at a worse price than waiting for a clear risk-on signal would offer.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）是指保留現金而非立即投入市場，這樣當真正出現強勢機會時才有資金可以運用。像今天這種中性盤整的日子，若只為了消化閒置現金而勉強買入，反而可能買在較差的價位，不如耐心等待明確的風險偏好訊號出現。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices were essentially flat today, with the NASDAQ edging up 0.2% and the S&P 500 slipping 0.1%, reflecting a lack of strong directional catalysts in the session. Trading appears range-bound as investors await clearer signals on rates or earnings before committing to a direction. Without a decisive move in either index, this reads as a consolidation day rather than a trend continuation or reversal.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走勢平淡，納斯達克指數微升0.2%，標普500指數則小跌0.1%，市場缺乏明確的方向性催化因素。交易呈現區間震盪格局，投資者似乎在等待利率或財報方面更清晰的訊號才會進一步表態。由於兩大指數皆未出現顯著波動，今日可視為盤整日，而非趨勢延續或反轉。
